The `style` variable here represents the style of the panel content/background. This style needs to be applied to the title text.

I need to check how `Text` objects are styled. If `self.title` is a string, `Text.from_markup` is used. If it's already a `Text` object, it's copied.

If I modify `_title` to apply the style, I need access to the style object.
